MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Fleetwood Mac, Hall & Oates, and Player fit the melodic classic rock and pop I have been choosing through The Cars and classic hits compilations.",
    "Artist-specific best-of collections feel like natural next choices because I have repeatedly chosen collections by Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Definitive Collection and Greatest Hits give me no artist connection, so I cannot tell whether they contain music I would enjoy.",
    "Road House does not establish a clear connection to the melodic songs and familiar performers I want right now.",
    "Elvis, Ricky Nelson, and Huey Lewis fit parts of my taste, but I would choose Fleetwood Mac, Hall & Oates, and Player first today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Calling something a greatest-hits collection seems to count too much when the performer and musical connection are unclear.",
    "Older music is treated as broadly interchangeable, although an older release alone does not make it a strong choice for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The strongest connection is melodic classic rock and pop from recognizable performers, rather than simply collections of older hits.",
    "For a mixed compilation such as One Hit Wonders, the actual songs matter: my interest in AM Gold does not mean I would choose any compilation without knowing its tracks."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in classic hits collections, but sometimes treated the collection label and era as enough without a clear musical connection."
}
